rewrites.//: Everything except real files falls through to the SPA. sw.js, manifest.json and assets are excluded so they are served as themselves — a service worker returned as index.html is rejected by the browser as an invalid script, which is what prevented the broken worker from ever being replaced.

headers.//: The kill-switch worker must never be cached, or browsers keep re-reading the old copy and stay broken.
index.html must always be revalidated so a deploy is picked up immediately.
